2. Data Handling & Permissions Policy

eBook Reader operates locally on your client device as an offline utility. Permission details:

  • READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE / MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: Granted locally on your device to open, read, edit, and save files. Your personal files are never uploaded to any external server.
  • POST_NOTIFICATIONS: Granted locally to display playback controls, recording status, or background operation updates.

3. Offline & Local Processing Guarantee

Core rendering engines—including EPUB parsing, PDF vector rendering, bookmark saving, and text-to-speech audio queuing—are executed 100% locally on client hardware.

We reserve the right to update this policy periodically. If you have questions, please contact us at:

docs/privacy_policy/en_gb.title: Privacy Policy
docs/privacy_policy/en_gb.subtitle: Docs
docs/privacy_policy/en_gb.content:
1. About this policy

This policy describes how the Docs application ("Docs" or the "App"), developed by Mohan MRKS, handles information when you use it. Docs is designed to manage and edit documents stored on your device. The App does not provide a developer-operated account or document-sync service.

2. Documents and local index

Your documents are read, edited, and saved on your device or at locations you select. Docs does not send document contents to a Docs server. To list, search, and organize files, the App keeps a local database containing file paths, names, extensions, sizes, modification times, favorite and protected status, and text previews extracted for search. This database and its previews remain on the device and are removed when the App's data is cleared or the App is uninstalled; files saved outside the App's private storage may remain.

On Android, Docs may request storage access, including all-files access on supported Android versions, to find and manage documents. On other platforms, access is provided through the platform's file selection and storage mechanisms.

3. Protected documents

When you choose Protect & Save, Docs encrypts the exported document using AES-256-GCM and a key derived from your password with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256. The password is not uploaded to the developer. Keep it safe: a forgotten password cannot be recovered by the developer, and may make that protected file inaccessible.

4. Diagnostics

For troubleshooting, Docs writes application error details, such as error messages and stack traces, to a diagnostics file in the App's private local storage. These reports are not automatically transmitted by Docs. The file is rotated locally as it grows. Error details can include information present in the error or diagnostic context, so avoid sharing diagnostic files unless you have reviewed them.

5. Network and third-party services

Some actions you initiate can communicate with services outside Docs, including downloading a file from a URL, opening a website in the in-app browser, sharing a file through your operating system, or contacting support by email. Those services may receive information such as your IP address, the requested URL, or the content you choose to share. Their own privacy policies apply. Docs does not control those services.

6. Data choices and contact

You can manage or delete documents using Docs and your device's file tools. Clearing the App's data removes its local index and diagnostics; it does not necessarily delete documents stored elsewhere on your device. For privacy questions, contact mohanmrks@yandex.com.

7. Changes

This policy may be updated as Docs changes. This policy may be updated periodically.

This Privacy Policy applies to the Knife Strike mobile application ("Application", "App", "Service"), developed by Mohan MRKS ("Developer"). Knife Strike is built with a "Privacy First" approach. We believe your personal data, high scores, and gaming experience belong exclusively to you.

2. Data Handling & Local Storage Policy

Knife Strike operates locally on your client device as an offline arcade game. We do not collect, harvest, transmit, or sell any personally identifiable information (PII). All gameplay progression—including unlocked stages, accumulated Rubles, unlocked custom blades, Cyrillic fonts, throwing indicator symbols, and precision statistics—is stored 100% locally on your device via secure client-side storage (SharedPreferences).

3. Device Permissions & Hardware Features

Knife Strike uses only the minimal device features necessary to deliver game mechanics:

  • HAPTIC FEEDBACK / VIBRATION: Used purely locally to provide tactile feedback during knife impacts and blade clashes. This permission does not access or transmit any personal data.
  • AUDIO: Used purely locally to play sound effects and procedural game audio. No microphone recording or audio surveillance is performed.
  • LOCAL NOTIFICATIONS: Used on-device only to deliver friendly optional reminders to play. No remote push notifications or tracking tokens are employed.

4. Third-Party Services & Network Activity

The Application does not maintain any remote user database or tracking servers. When you click external links—such as sharing your level victory status or contacting customer support—you interact with standard third-party platform dialogs (email client, system share sheet) that operate under their own terms.

5. Children's Privacy (COPPA Compliance)

Knife Strike contains no age-inappropriate content, behavioral tracking, or personal data collection, fully complying with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and international privacy frameworks.
